# Foundation Requirements Checklist: Call Center Agent Automation

**Purpose**: Assess the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of initial
repository-setup requirements before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md)
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience and Timing**: Peer reviewer, before task generation and implementation review

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` for the initial repository
foundation. It reviews requirements writing, not application behavior or implementation completion.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is reviewer-owned. Mark an item `[x]` only after the reviewer
determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality; it does not mean
implementation work is complete. All newly generated items are intentionally unchecked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are both application foundations, their basic health requirements, and the starter-test and automation deliverables explicitly included in the initial milestone? [Completeness, Spec FR-030]
- [x] CHK002 Are default setup requirements explicitly independent of provisioned cloud resources, external-service credentials, and live integration access? [Completeness, Spec FR-031, SC-016]
- [x] CHK003 Are prerequisites and equivalent onboarding requirements documented for both Windows and Linux, rather than only one developer environment? [Completeness, Spec FR-032, SC-017]
- [x] CHK004 Are source organization, independently packaged applications, container deliverables, and automation configuration responsibilities documented as foundation requirements? [Completeness, Plan Project Structure]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the boundary between dependency installation and cloud-independent application startup defined, including which network access belongs to each stage? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions: Cloud-independent setup verification]
- [x] CHK006 Are liveness, local readiness, and readiness for live call functionality defined as different claims with explicit acceptance meanings? [Clarity, Spec FR-030, Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK007 Is a runnable management foundation clearly distinguished from a functional agent editor or an interactive agent-testing product? [Clarity, Spec FR-030, Assumptions: Future management testing]
- [x] CHK008 Are port-selection, process-ownership, and cleanup responsibilities described sufficiently to avoid ambiguous local setup instructions? [Clarity, Gap, Quickstart Start Both Applications]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are all foundation acceptance criteria consistent with deferring live calls, configuration workflows, and call-capacity qualification to subsequent delivery? [Consistency, Spec FR-030, SC-015, Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK010 Are live-database and model-integration requirements reconciled with the requirement for cloud-independent setup, without implying that local stand-ins prove production durability? [Consistency, Spec FR-031, Plan Technical Context]
- [x] CHK011 Is the all-sources-under-code requirement consistent with the explicitly documented exception for required workflow discovery metadata? [Consistency, Plan Project Structure]
- [x] CHK012 Are the selected agent-library requirements consistent with credential-free startup and with deferring actual agent orchestration workflows? [Consistency, Spec FR-031, Plan Primary Dependencies]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Do the setup success criteria specify observable evidence for two separately usable applications and their respective health declarations? [Measurability, Spec SC-015]
- [x] CHK014 Are successful starter-test results distinguished from evidence that a deliberately failing assertion causes a failed automation gate? [Measurability, Spec SC-015]
- [x] CHK015 Are the required absence of credentials and zero live-service requests stated as objective acceptance conditions rather than assumed properties? [Measurability, Spec SC-016]
- [x] CHK016 Are cross-platform evidence requirements and timing budgets tied to defined environments and dependency-preparation conditions? [Measurability, Spec SC-017, Plan Performance Goals]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements complete for the primary fresh-checkout journey from documented prerequisites through the foundation's acceptance boundary? [Coverage, Spec SC-015, SC-017]
- [x] CHK018 Are native-development and container-based onboarding alternatives explicitly distinguished, including their platform-support obligations? [Coverage, Spec FR-032, Plan Testing, Target Platform]
- [x] CHK019 Are exception requirements defined for invalid local configuration and unavailable dependencies without silently selecting a different operating mode? [Coverage, Gap, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK020 Are recovery expectations documented for interrupted setup or startup, including retry safety and disposal of partial local process state? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for occupied ports, an already-running unrelated application, and partially available application foundations? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap, Quickstart Start Both Applications]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for missing or stale dependency locks, incompatible dependency versions, and unavailable installation prerequisites? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap, Plan Primary Dependencies]
- [x] CHK023 Are the local-only diagnostic surface's exposure limits, invalid-input boundaries, and shutdown expectations explicitly specified? [Coverage, Edge Case, Contracts Local Synthetic WebSocket]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are security requirements for unauthenticated health information, local diagnostic access, and unavailable business functionality explicit and mutually consistent? [Security, Spec FR-020, FR-030, Contracts Delivery Status]
- [x] CHK025 Are foundation logging requirements defined for structured events, correlation, safe errors, and exclusion of secrets or content-bearing telemetry? [Completeness, Constitution VII, Plan Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK026 Are meaningful automated assertions, required failure gates, and reviewable results stated as requirements rather than equated with the presence of test files? [Completeness, Constitution IX, Spec SC-015]
- [x] CHK027 Are responsiveness and accessibility expectations scoped explicitly to the initial management shell rather than only to later editing workflows? [Coverage, Gap, Spec FR-025, Plan Summary]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Are supported runtime versions, dependency compatibility, reproducible installation, and responsibility for the chosen toolchain's prerequisites documented? [Dependency, Plan Language/Version, Primary Dependencies]
- [x] CHK029 Are native platform support, container support, internet access during installation, and cloud access during live integration identified as separate assumptions? [Assumption, Spec FR-031, FR-032, Plan Target Platform]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements for local static checks, peer-review automation, and later privileged publication or deployment separated so foundation acceptance does not require production credentials? [Dependency, Plan Project Structure, Constraints]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK031 Is the meaning of foundation completion consistent across the spec, plan, contracts, and quickstart, without suggesting the entire call-center feature is complete? [Conflict, Spec Assumptions: Initial repository setup milestone, Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK032 Are pending version-compatibility decisions and later production approvals clearly distinguished from already-established foundation requirements? [Ambiguity, Assumption, Plan Primary Dependencies, Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Scope selected by the user: initial repository setup only; standard peer-review depth.
- This is not a production-release checklist or an assessment of the complete call-center stories.
  Later agent orchestration, telephony qualification, customer-facing workflows, and production
  capacity are included only where their deferral affects foundation requirement clarity.
- No item has been evaluated or approved by this generation command. A reference identifies
  the requirement to review; it does not assert that the requirement already passes.
- `[Gap]`, `[Ambiguity]`, `[Conflict]`, and `[Assumption]` identify requirements-review prompts,
  not completed implementation findings. Add reviewer evidence or explanations alongside items.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
  Leave unresolved items unchecked.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify checkbox markers.
- The built-in [requirements.md](requirements.md) checklist has a separate lifecycle maintained
  by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`; this custom checklist does not change it.
- Source context: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md),
  [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md), [interface contracts](../contracts/interfaces.md),
  and the [constitution](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md).
